blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Medical Physics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
Medical Physics: Introduction and Radiations Used

blocks.prompt:
1 What is medical physics?
(Medical physics kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Medical physics physics ki woh shaakh hai jo physical usool aur techniques medicine par lagati hai, khaas taur par bimariyon ki tashkhees (diagnosis) aur ilaaj mein. Yeh physics aur medical science ko mila kar aisi technologies banati hai jin se doctors jism ke andar dekh aur mehfooz ilaaj kar sakein.

book_ref.quote: It combines knowledge of physics with medical science for the development and use of technologies.

blocks.prompt:
2 Name four technologies through which medical physics is used in hospitals, and state how they help.
(Chaar technologies ke naam likhein jin ke zariye medical physics hospitals mein istemaal hoti hai, aur batayein woh kaise madad karti hain.)
blocks.explanation: X-ray imaging, ultrasound scans, CT scans aur PET scans. In se doctors haddi ka toot (fracture) dhoondte, tumor ki tashkhees karte aur surgery ke baghair andarooni aaza dekhte hain; is se jaldi tashkhees aur behtar ilaaj hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, medical physics directly contributes to early diagnosis, effective treatment, and improved quality of life.

blocks.prompt:
3 Define radiation. For what two purposes is it used in medical physics?
(Radiation ki definition likhein. Medical physics mein yeh kin do maqasid ke liye istemaal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radiation khala (space) ya maadde mein waves ya particles ki shakal mein energy ki muntaqili hai. Medical physics mein yeh zyada tar tashkhees (imaging) aur ilaaj ke liye istemaal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Radiation is the transfer of energy through space or matter in the form of waves or particles.

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between ionizing and non-ionizing radiation, with medical examples.
(Ionizing aur non-ionizing radiation mein farq medical misalon ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Radiation is broadly classified into non-ionizing and ionizing radiation.

rows: Itni energy ke atoms se electrons nikaal kar ions banaye
Atoms se electrons nikalne jitni energy nahin
Misalein: X-rays, gamma rays, positrons
Misalein: ultrasound waves, radiowaves
X-rays aur gamma rays photoelectric effect aur Compton scattering se interact karti hain
Waves maadde se reflect, refract ya absorb hoti hain
X-ray imaging, CT, PET aur cancer ke ilaaj mein
Ultrasound imaging aur MRI mein

blocks.prompt:
5 Why are gamma rays used in nuclear medicine and cancer treatment?
(Gamma rays nuclear medicine aur cancer ke ilaaj mein kyun istemaal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Apni zyada guzarne ki salahiyat (penetrating power) ki wajah se. Yeh PET scans jaisi nuclear medicine aur cancer ke ilaaj mein istemaal hoti hain, jabke X-rays aam taur par haddiyon aur andarooni aaza ki tasweer ke liye.

book_ref.quote: X-rays are commonly used to image bones and internal organs

blocks.prompt:
6 How are radiowaves used in medical imaging, and what is their advantage?
(Medical imaging mein radiowaves kaise istemaal hoti hain aur un ka faida kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radiowaves MRI mein istemaal hoti hain jahan woh atomic nuclei se interact kar ke andarooni banawat ki tafseeli tasaveer banati hain. Yeh naram tissues ki imaging ke liye khaas mufeed hain kyunke nuqsandeh (ionizing) radiation nahin hoti.

book_ref.quote: making them especially useful for imaging soft tissues without harmful radiation exposure

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the role of the transducer in ultrasound imaging?
(Ultrasound imaging mein transducer ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transducer ka dohra kirdar hai: yeh jism mein bheji jane wali ultrasound waves paida karta hai aur jism ke andar se reflect ho kar aane wale signals detect karta hai. Yeh piezoelectric effect par kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This imaging method operates on a physical principle known as the piezoelectric effect

blocks.prompt:
8 What is the origin of the word "piezoelectric"?
(Lafz "piezoelectric" kahan se aaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh Yunani lafz "piezein" (yaani dabana) aur "electric" (bijli paida hona) se bana hai. Yaani dabane se paida hone wali bijli.

book_ref.quote: comes from the Greek word "piezein," which means "to press"

blocks.prompt:
9 Who discovered the piezoelectric effect, and what did they find?
(Piezoelectric effect kis ne daryaft kiya aur unhein kya maloom hua?)
blocks.explanation: Pierre Curie aur Jacques Curie (France) ne 1880 mein. Quartz, tourmaline aur Rochelle salt par kaam karte hue unhon ne dekha ke in crystals par mechanical dabao se electric charge paida hota hai; yani mechanical force aur barqi jawab mein gehra taalluq hai.

book_ref.quote: Their experiments proved a strong connection between mechanical force and electrical response in certain crystals.

blocks.prompt:
10 Why do only some crystals show the piezoelectric effect?
(Sirf kuch crystals hi piezoelectric effect kyun dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Un ki khaas andarooni banawat ki wajah se: un mein centre of symmetry nahin hota aur positive aur negative charge ke chhote hisse hote hain. Yeh aam taur par barabar hote hain; dabao se thora hil jate hain aur surface par field aa jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The piezoelectric effect is possible because of the unique internal structure of some crystals.

blocks.prompt:
11 Distinguish between the direct and the converse piezoelectric effect.
(Direct aur converse piezoelectric effect mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: There are two types of piezoelectric effect, direct piezoelectric effect and converse piezoelectric effect.

rows: Crystal par mechanical dabao lagaya jata hai
Crystal par electric field lagai jati hai
Charges ka tawazun bigarta hai aur surface par electric field aati hai
Crystal ki shakal thori badal jati hai
Dabao voltage mein badalta hai
Voltage shakal ki tabdeeli (dabao) mein badalta hai
Transducer wapas aane wale echoes isi se detect karta hai
Voltage lagne par transducer crystal ki shakal isi se badalti hai

blocks.prompt:
12 Name three natural crystals and one manufactured material that show the piezoelectric effect.
(Piezoelectric effect dikhane wale teen qudrati crystals aur aik banaye gaye material ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Crystals: quartz, tourmaline aur Rochelle salt (sodium potassium tartrate). Fig. 20.1 wala material lead zirconate titanate (PZT) hai. Aise materials dabao ko voltage mein aur voltage ko dabao mein badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The piezoelectric effect makes it possible to turn pressure into voltage and vice versa.

blocks.text: 20.2 Diagnostic Use of Ultrasound in Medical Imaging

blocks.prompt:
13 What is the frequency range of medical ultrasound, and how are the waves sent into the body?
(Medical ultrasound ki frequency range kya hai aur waves jism mein kaise bheji jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aam taur par 1 MHz se 15 MHz. Transducer yeh oonchi frequency ki awaaz ki waves jism mein bhejta hai; woh guzarti aur mukhtalif tissues ki sarhadon se reflect hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: These waves travel through the body and reflect off boundaries between different tissues.

blocks.prompt:
14 Why is ultrasound called a safe and repeatable imaging method?
(Ultrasound ko mehfooz aur bar bar kiya jane wala imaging tareeqa kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke is mein ionizing radiation nahin, awaaz ki waves hain. Is liye yeh mehfooz, non-invasive aur bar bar kiya ja sakta hai, maslan hamal ke dauran.

book_ref.quote: One of the key advantages of ultrasound is that it does not use ionizing radiation

blocks.prompt:
15 What is acoustic impedance, and why is it important in ultrasound imaging?
(Acoustic impedance kya hai aur ultrasound imaging mein kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acoustic impedance tissue ki aik khasoosiyat hai jo us ki density aur us mein awaaz ki raftaar se tay hoti hai. Jahan mukhtalif acoustic impedance wale do tissues milte hain wahan wave ka kuch hissa reflect hota hai; yehi echoes tasweer banate hain.

book_ref.quote: part of the wave is reflected

blocks.prompt:
16 How does the ultrasound transducer detect the returning echoes?
(Ultrasound transducer wapas aane wale echoes kaise detect karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulse bhejne ke baad transducer receive mode mein chala jata hai. Wapas aane wale echoes us ke crystal ko dabate hain aur direct piezoelectric effect se electrical signals ban jate hain jinhein machine process karti hai.

book_ref.quote: The transducer then switches to receive mode

blocks.prompt:
17 How does the computer build the ultrasound image from the echoes? Why do some areas look brighter?
(Computer echoes se ultrasound image kaise banata hai? Kuch hisse zyada roshan kyun dikhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Computer har wapas aane wale echo ki der (time delay) aur shiddat (intensity) ka hisaab lagata hai; der se sarhad ki jagah aur intensity se roshni tay hoti hai. Zyada taaqatwar reflection wale hisse zyada roshan dikhte hain.

book_ref.quote: helping to reveal the internal structures of organs and tissues

blocks.prompt:
18 An echo from the far wall of an organ returns 130 μs after the pulse is sent. Taking the speed of sound in tissue as 1540 m s⁻¹, how deep is the wall?
(Organ ki pichhli deewar se echo pulse ke 130 μs baad wapas aata hai. Tissue mein awaaz ki raftaar 1540 m s⁻¹ le kar deewar kitni gehrai par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Awaaz deewar tak ja kar wapas aati hai, is liye gehrai d = vt/2 = 1540 × 130 × 10⁻⁶ / 2 = 0.100 m = 10.0 cm.

book_ref.quote: The reflected echoes are then collected and analyzed to create an image.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Echo ka waqt aane aur jaane dono ka hai, is liye faasla nikalne ke liye vt ko 2 se taqseem karna zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the wavelength of 3.0 MHz ultrasound in a tissue in which sound travels at 1540 m s⁻¹ (use v = fλ).
(Jis tissue mein awaaz 1540 m s⁻¹ se chalti ho us mein 3.0 MHz ultrasound ki wavelength maloom karein (v = fλ istemaal karein).)

book_ref.quote: Ultrasound is a widely used medical imaging technique that allows doctors to view internal body structures in real time.

blocks.prompt:
20 Give two uses of ultrasound in obstetrics and two in the abdominal region.
(Obstetrics mein ultrasound ke do aur pet (abdomen) mein do istemaal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Obstetrics: fetus ki nashonuma dekhna aur hamal ki umar (gestational age) ka andaza (hamal ki kharabiyan bhi). Pet: liver aur kidneys dekhna (gallbladder, pancreas aur bladder bhi).

book_ref.quote: Ultrasound imaging is extensively used across various medical specialties for diagnostic purposes.

blocks.prompt:
21 What is echocardiography?
(Echocardiography kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh cardiology mein ultrasound ka istemaal hai; is se doctors dil ki banawat aur kaam ko foran (real time) jaanchte hain.

book_ref.quote: In cardiology, echo cardiography allows doctors to evaluate

blocks.prompt:
22 How is ultrasound used in urology and in the musculoskeletal system?
(Urology aur musculoskeletal system mein ultrasound kaise istemaal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Urology: prostate, testicles aur urinary system dekhne ke liye. Musculoskeletal system: ligament ki chot, joron ki sozish aur doosre naram tissue ke masail dhoondne ke liye.

book_ref.quote: Additionally, in the musculoskeletal system

blocks.prompt:
23 How does the acoustic impedance difference between two tissues affect an ultrasound image?
(Do tissues ke darmiyan acoustic impedance ka farq ultrasound image par kya asar dalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada farq (maslan naram tissue aur haddi) zyada taaqatwar echoes deta hai, is liye sarhad tasweer mein saaf dikhti hai. Kam farq kamzor echoes aur dhundli sarhaden deta hai.

book_ref.quote: causes stronger echoes, producing clearer boundaries in the image

blocks.prompt:
24 Compare high frequency and low frequency ultrasound for imaging.
(Imaging ke liye zyada frequency aur kam frequency ultrasound ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Frequency of Ultrasound: Higher frequency ultrasound offers better resolution

Tasweer kam saaf
Kam gehrai tak jata hai

Satah ke qareeb cheezon ke liye munasib
Gehre aaza ke liye munasib

blocks.prompt:
25 Why is a gel applied between the transducer and the skin during an ultrasound scan?
(Ultrasound scan ke dauran transducer aur jild ke darmiyan gel kyun lagai jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transducer aur jild ke darmiyan hawa ke khala khatam karne ke liye. Hawa awaaz ko rokti hai; gel se awaaz ki waves jism mein behtar guzarti hain.

book_ref.quote: Use of Gel: A special gel is applied between the transducer and the skin

blocks.prompt:
26 How can ultrasound measure the speed of blood flow?
(Ultrasound khoon ke bahao ki raftaar kaise naap sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doppler effect se: chalte khoon se reflect hone wala ultrasound badli hui frequency ke saath wapas aata hai; frequency ki is tabdeeli ko pakar kar khoon ki raftaar maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Ultrasound can even measure blood flow speed using the Doppler effect

blocks.prompt:
27 Why do electron transitions in hydrogen give visible or ultraviolet light, but inner-shell transitions in heavy atoms give X-rays?
(Hydrogen mein electron transitions visible ya ultraviolet roshni kyun deti hain jabke bhaari atoms ki andarooni shell transitions X-rays?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen aur halke elements mein levels ke darmiyan energy ka farq chhota hai, is liye photons infrared, visible ya ultraviolet mein hote hain. Bhaari atoms mein andarooni electrons mazbooti se bandhe hain, farq bara hai, is liye zyada energy ke photons (X-rays) nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: due to small energy differences in the transition levels

blocks.prompt:
28 How are electrons arranged in heavy atoms according to the chapter?
(Chapter ke mutabiq bhaari atoms mein electrons kaise tarteeb diye gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hum-markaz (concentric) shells mein jin ke naam K, L, M, N, O waghera hain. K-shell nucleus ke sab se qareeb, phir L-shell, waghera (Fig. 20.3). Andarooni electrons mazbooti se bandhe hote hain.

book_ref.quote: In heavy atoms, the electrons are assumed to be arranged in concentric shells labelled as K, L, M, N, O, etc.

blocks.prompt:
29 What are characteristic X-rays, and why are they important?
(Characteristic X-rays kya hain aur kyun ahem hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bhaari atoms ki andarooni shell transitions se nikalne wali X-rays; yeh makhsoos wavelengths ki series hain jin ki energy target material par munhasir hai. In ke mutale ne atom ki banawat aur periodic table samajhne mein ahem kirdar ada kiya.

book_ref.quote: and hence are called characteristic X-rays

blocks.prompt:
30 Briefly describe how electrons are produced and accelerated in an X-ray tube.
(X-ray tube mein electrons kaise paida aur tez kiye jate hain, mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: X-ray tube high vacuum tube hai. Filament F se garam cathode C electrons kharij karta hai jo potential difference V se anode (target) T ki taraf tez hote hain aur (K.E.)max = Ve se takrate hain.

book_ref.quote: it emits electrons which are accelerated towards the anode T

blocks.prompt:
31 How is a Kα X-ray produced? Write its energy equation.
(Kα X-ray kaise banti hai? Is ki energy ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Tez electron target atom ka K-shell electron nikaal deta hai aur khali jagah (hole) ban jati hai. L-shell ka electron is hole mein aata hai aur photon kharij karta hai, yehi Kα X-ray hai: hf(Kα) = E_L − E_K.

book_ref.quote: the electrons in the innermost shells, such as K or L, will be knocked out

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between Kα and Kβ X-rays.
(Kα aur Kβ X-rays mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: It is also possible that the electron from the M-shell might also jump

rows: L-shell ka electron K-shell ka hole bharta hai
M-shell ka electron K-shell ka hole bharta hai
hf = E_L − E_K
hf = E_M − E_K
Kam photon energy, lambi wavelength
Zyada photon energy, chhoti wavelength

blocks.prompt:
33 Why does the X-ray spectrum from a tube show sharp lines on top of a continuous curve?
(X-ray tube ke spectrum mein continuous curve ke ooper tez lines kyun nazar aati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Do amal saath hote hain. Target mein andarooni shell transitions muqarrar energy ki characteristic X-rays deti hain jo alag lines dikhti hain; rukne wale electrons ki bremsstrahlung λmin se ooper har wavelength deti hai jo continuous spectrum hai (Fig. 20.6).

book_ref.quote: The characteristic X-rays appear as discrete lines on a continuous spectrum as shown in Fig. 20.6.

blocks.prompt:
34 Electrons in an X-ray tube are accelerated through 60 kV. Find their maximum kinetic energy in joules (e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).
(X-ray tube mein electrons 60 kV se tez kiye jate hain. Un ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy joules mein maloom karein (e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).)

book_ref.quote: If V is the potential difference between C and T

blocks.prompt:
35 In a target atom E_K = −70.0 keV and E_L = −11.0 keV. Find the energy of the Kα photon in keV and in joules (1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).
(Aik target atom mein E_K = −70.0 keV aur E_L = −11.0 keV hai. Kα photon ki energy keV aur joules mein maloom karein (1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).)

book_ref.quote: Suppose that one of the electrons in the K-shell is removed

blocks.prompt:
36 What is bremsstrahlung? Why is it in the X-ray region?
(Bremsstrahlung kya hai? Yeh X-ray region mein kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bremsstrahlung (braking radiation) woh radiation hai jo tez electrons target se achanak rukne par kharij karte hain, kyunke accelerated charge electromagnetic radiation deta hai. Rukne ki sharah bohat zyada hai, is liye wavelength chhoti aur X-ray region mein hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The continuous spectrum is due to an effect known as bremsstrahlung or braking radiation.

blocks.prompt:
37 Why does the continuous X-ray spectrum have a sharp minimum wavelength λmin?
(Continuous X-ray spectrum ki aik tez had (minimum wavelength λmin) kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Koi photon electron ki zyada se zyada K.E. (Ve) se zyada energy nahin rakh sakta. Jab electron pehli takkar mein saari energy kho de to hf_max = Ve, sab se oonchi frequency aur is liye sab se chhoti wavelength λmin = hc/(Ve).

book_ref.quote: In the case when the electrons lose all their kinetic energy in the first collision

blocks.prompt:
38 How is the continuous part of the X-ray spectrum formed?
(X-ray spectrum ka continuous hissa kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aksar electrons aik takkar mein saari energy nahin khote; rukne se pehle kai takkaren khate hain. Har rukawat kam energy (lambi wavelength) ka photon deti hai, is liye λmin se lambi tamam wavelengths aati hain aur continuous spectrum banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Other electrons do not lose all their energy in the first collision.

blocks.prompt:
39 An X-ray tube operates at 80 kV. Find the shortest wavelength of the X-rays produced (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).
(X-ray tube 80 kV par chalti hai. Paida hone wali X-rays ki sab se chhoti wavelength maloom karein (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).)

book_ref.quote: Hence, these impacting electrons emit radiation as they are strongly decelerated by the target.

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between the continuous X-ray spectrum and characteristic X-rays.
(Continuous X-ray spectrum aur characteristic X-rays mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: the emitted radiation correspond to short wavelength

Target atoms mein andarooni shell electrons ki transitions se
λmin se ooper tamam wavelengths

blocks.prompt:
41 What is attenuation of X-rays? State the attenuation law.
(X-rays ki attenuation kya hai? Attenuation ka qanoon likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Attenuation X-rays ka jism mein se guzarte hue atoms se interact kar ke (maslan unhein ionize kar ke) energy khona hai. Intensity exponential tareeqe se kam hoti hai: I = I₀e^(−μx), jahan x motai aur μ attenuation coefficient hai.

book_ref.quote: As X-rays travel through the body, they lose energy because they interact with atoms.

blocks.prompt:
42 On what factors does the attenuation coefficient μ depend? What is its unit when x is in metres?
(Attenuation coefficient μ kin cheezon par munhasir hai? Jab x metres mein ho to is ki unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: μ material aur X-ray ki energy par munhasir hai. Exponent mein μx be-unit hona chahiye aur x metres mein hai, is liye μ ki unit m⁻¹ hai.

book_ref.quote: μ = attenuation coefficient (depends on the material and X-ray energy)

blocks.prompt:
43 An X-ray beam passes through 3.0 cm of a material with μ = 40 m⁻¹. What fraction of the initial intensity emerges?
(X-ray beam μ = 40 m⁻¹ wale material ki 3.0 cm motai se guzarti hai. Shuruaati intensity ka kitna hissa bahar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: μx = 40 × 0.030 = 1.2; I/I₀ = e^(−1.2) = 0.30, yaani taqreeban 30% bahar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: The intensity of the X-ray beam decreases gradually as it passes through a material.

blocks.prompt:
44 Why are hard X-rays used for bones but soft X-rays for the breast?
(Haddiyon ke liye hard X-rays aur breast ke liye soft X-rays kyun istemaal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: X-ray image mein contrast X-ray energy par munhasir hai. Hard (zyada energy) X-rays haddiyon ki imaging mein achha contrast deti hain, jabke soft (kam energy) X-rays breast jaise naram tissues mein farq karne ke liye behtar hain.

book_ref.quote: Contrast depends on x-rays energy.

blocks.prompt:
45 What are contrast media? Why do they make tissues stand out?
(Contrast media kya hain? Yeh tissues ko numayan kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khaas cheezen jaise iodine (Z = 53) ya barium (Z = 56) jo X-rays achhi tarah jazb karti hain; inhein injection se ya nigal kar diya jata hai. Zyada atomic number X-ray absorption barhata hai, is liye woh hisse saaf numayan hote hain.

book_ref.quote: They are injected or swallowed to highlight certain parts of the body.

blocks.prompt:
46 What is the use of an image intensifier?
(Image intensifier ka kya istemaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh foran X-ray imaging (fluoroscopy) mein istemaal hota hai. Yeh tasweer roshan kar ke dekhna aasan banata hai aur mareez par radiation ka asar kam karne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: They help reduce radiation exposure by brightening the image, making it easier to see.

blocks.prompt:
47 What is computed tomography (CT)? Give two of its uses.
(Computed tomography (CT) kya hai? Is ke do istemaal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: CT aik imaging technique hai jo X-ray technology aur computer processing ko mila kar andarooni banawat ki saaf cross-sectional aur 3D tasaveer banati hai. Istemaal: bimariyon ki tashkhees, andarooni chot ka pata (ilaaj ki rehnumai bhi).

book_ref.quote: It is especially useful for diagnosing diseases, detecting internal injuries, and guiding medical treatment.

blocks.prompt:
48 How does a CT scanner produce a single slice image?
(CT scanner aik slice ki tasweer kaise banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoom kar aik hi hisse ki mukhtalif zawiyon se bohat si X-ray tasaveer leti hai aur detectors beam record karte hain. Computer in tasaveer ko jor kar aik tafseeli cross-sectional (slice) tasweer banata hai.

book_ref.quote: A computer combines these images to make a detailed cross-sectional (slice) image of the body.

blocks.prompt:
49 Explain the three words in the name Computed Axial Tomography.
(Computed Axial Tomography ke naam ke teen alfaaz ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Computed: computer data process karta hai. Axial: scan jism ke axis (jism mein se guzarne wali line) ke saath liya jata hai. Tomography: Yunani lafz tomos (slice) se, kyunke jism tah ba tah dekha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The name computed tomography comes from:

blocks.prompt:
50 Who invented the CT scanner, and what recognition did they receive?
(CT scanner kis ne ijad kiya aur unhein kya aizaz mila?)
blocks.explanation: Sir Godfrey Hounsfield (England) aur Allan Cormack (South Africa) ne 1970s ke shuru mein. Dono ko 1979 mein Physiology ya Medicine ka Nobel Prize mila.

book_ref.quote: The CT-scanner was invented by Sir Godfrey Hounsfield (England) and Allan Cormack (South Africa) in the early 1970s.

blocks.prompt:
51 How does CT build a three-dimensional image of the body?
(CT jism ki teen-dimensional (3D) tasweer kaise banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik slice ke baad scanner jism ke saath thora aage barh kar agli slice banata hai. Phir computer tamam slices ko, cake ki tahon ki tarah, jor kar andarooni banawat ki 3D tasweer banata hai.

book_ref.quote: In the end, all these slices are combined by the computer to create a 3D image of the internal structure.

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between an ordinary X-ray image and a CT scan.
(Aam X-ray tasweer aur CT scan mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: CT scans offer several important advantages over traditional X-rays.

(CT scan tumor ke ilaaj mein kaise madad karta hai?)

blocks.prompt:
54 Why do doctors take special precautions before a CT scan of a pregnant woman?
(Haamla khatoon ke CT scan se pehle doctors khaas ehtiyat kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke CT scan mein X-rays ka saamna hota hai jo ionizing radiation hai aur thora khatra rakhti hai. Is liye khaas ehtiyat ki jati hai, khaas taur par haamla khawateen aur pehle se beemar mareezon ke liye.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, doctors take special precautions

blocks.prompt:
55 How does nuclear medicine imaging differ from X-ray imaging in the source of radiation?
(Nuclear medicine imaging radiation ke source mein X-ray imaging se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: X-ray imaging mein radiation jism ke bahar tube se aati hai aur banawat (anatomy) dikhati hai. Nuclear medicine mein radiation mareez ke andar diye gaye radiopharmaceutical se aati hai, is liye signal jism ka kaam (physiological function) bhi dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: In nuclear medicine, the radiation originates inside the patient

57 What is annihilation in PET?
(PET mein annihilation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tracer se nikla positron tissue mein thora faasla tay kar ke electron se milta hai; dono khatam ho jate hain aur un ka mass do gamma photons ki energy ban jata hai jo taqreeban mukhalif simton mein jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
58 Why can PET detect disease before anatomical changes appear? Give two uses.
(PET banawat mein tabdeeli se pehle bimari kaise pakar leta hai? Do istemaal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke PET cellular/molecular satah par metabolic aur biochemical sargarmi dikhata hai, yeh banawat ki wazeh tabdeeli se pehle ghair maamooli kaam dikha deta hai. Istemaal: cancer ki jaldi tashkhees aur staging, dimagh ke kaam ka jaiza (dil ki kharabiyan bhi).

book_ref.quote: making it highly valuable for early cancer detection and staging

blocks.prompt:
59 Why does a PET tracer collect more in cancers and in working parts of the brain?
(PET tracer cancers aur dimagh ke kaam karte hisson mein zyada kyun jama hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rag mein diya gaya tracer khoon ke saath jata hai aur zyada sargarm tissues mein zyada jama hota hai, maslan aksar cancers aur dimagh aur dil ke kaam karte hisse. Is liye yeh hisse roshan dikhte hain.

book_ref.quote: The tracer is carried by the blood

blocks.prompt:
60 How are the gamma photons detected in a PET scanner and turned into an image?
(PET scanner mein gamma photons kaise detect hote aur tasweer mein badalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mareez ke gird ring mein lage detectors photon pairs detect kar ke computer ko signals bhejte hain. Computer tasweer banata hai jo dikhati hai tracer kahan jama hua; roshan hisse zyada tracer aur zyada sargarmi zahir karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Detectors arranged in a ring around the patient detect these photon pairs

blocks.prompt:
61 An electron and a positron (each of mass 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg) annihilate at rest. Find the total energy released (c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).
(Aik electron aur aik positron (har aik ka mass 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg) sakoon mein annihilate hote hain. Kul kharij hone wali energy maloom karein (c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).)
blocks.explanation: Kul mass = 2 × 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ = 1.822 × 10⁻³⁰ kg. E = mc² = 1.822 × 10⁻³⁰ × (3.00 × 10⁸)² = 1.64 × 10⁻¹³ J, jo do gamma photons mein barabar banti hai.

book_ref.quote: When they meet, the positron and electron annihilate
